name: Elephant
description: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d10+3 physical damage.

abilities.name: Toss
abilities.description: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra 1d12 damage.
